title: Security, Privacy & Infrastructure — Production Pilot Control Baseline
purpose: Turn prior architecture, stack, data, search, privacy and operational decisions into implementable controls, evidence and public-pilot release gates.

in: observability, security detection and incident response

decisions.decision: Single-host OVH Pilot is conditionally allowed; no high-availability claim.
decisions.condition: OVH-G01—06 and CNT-01—11 pass with evidence.

decisions.decision: Production Admin identity and authorization are server-enforced.
decisions.condition: Managed OIDC, MFA, session, role/action/resource policy and append-only audit.
Optional analytics remains off until consent, retention and legal gates pass.

decisions.decision: Recovery and monitoring are release gates.
decisions.condition: Off-host backup, continuous WAL, restore drill, detection and incident runbook pass.
A configured control is not passed without test/config/report/restore evidence.

hosting.topology: Single dedicated host, Docker Compose; Caddy is the only public ingress on TCP 80/443.
hosting.availabilityClaim: No high-availability claim. RAID1 is not backup.
hosting.fallback: Evaluate fallback when a release gate fails, repeated restore fails, capacity reserve is lost or outage risk exceeds approved Pilot tolerance.

privacy.mode: Guest-first; essential processing only by default.
privacy.optionalAnalytics: OFF until explicit consent, withdrawal, retention, vendor and legal review pass.
privacy.legalState: Technical/Product proposal only; Lao-law and vendor review remain required.

proposedObjectives.status: Not an SLO until a timed isolated restore passes.

releaseBlockers: two consecutive backup or restore failures

observability.pipeline: Pino/OpenTelemetry → Grafana Alloy → Grafana Cloud Loki/Mimir/Tempo/Alerting
observability.securityMode: SIEM-ready Pilot; not a full managed SIEM or 24×7 human SOC.
observability.approvedCoverage: Human 08:00–22:00 ICT daily; external alerts and safe automated actions 24×7.
observability.s1Response: Alert delivery and approved safe automation are 24x7. Human acknowledgement within 60 minutes is committed only during 08:00–22:00 ICT; outside coverage is best effort until backup On-call or managed service exists.

review.decision: Conditionally approved: single-host OVH Pilot, no HA claim, all OVH-G01—06 and CNT-01—11 evidence required.
Approved controls: managed OIDC, MFA, IAM-01—08 and 30m/12h/15m session baseline; provider remains pending.
Approved Technical/Product baseline; optional analytics remains off pending consent, vendor and legal review.
Approved target RPO ≤1h and RTO ≤8h; no SLO claim until timed restore passes.

Approved SIEM-ready Pilot with 08:00–22:00 ICT human coverage and 24×7 alert/safe automation. S1 acknowledgement ≤60 minutes is committed only during coverage; outside coverage is best effort until backup On-call or managed service exists.

disclaimer: Approved Design/Operations baseline; not legal advice, not Public Pilot approval and not proof that any implementation control has passed.
